hero.title: Walking the Work Through Venice
hero.lede: The studio leaves Tesa 41 with the works strapped to its back, sets them down in a campo, on a fondamenta or before a church, and carries them home another way. On 18 November students of the Accademia di Belle Arti take them by boat to the Academy; on 21 November the last walk goes to Piazza San Marco; on 22 November, the closing day, we gather at the pavilion.

acc.title: Walking the Work to the Accademia
acc.lede: The Accademia di Belle Arti di Venezia hosts Walking the Work Through Venice, a performance of Zadik Zadikian: The Studio. The works go by boat from the pavilion to the Zattere, and students of Prof. Gianpaolo Mazzoni’s sculpture course, who helped make them in Tesa 41, carry them on their backs into the Academy, for an hour with its professors and students.
acc.note: The meeting in the cloister is for the Academy’s students and staff. The works go there and back by boat, from the pavilion’s water gate on the Rio delle Galeazze.

sched.text: Meet at the door of Tesa 41 on the Fondamenta Case Nuove ten minutes before the time. Anyone may walk alongside. On 18 November the works go to the Accademia by boat, and the hour in its cloister (11:00–12:00) is for the Academy’s students and staff. The last walk, on 21 November, ends in Piazza San Marco; on 22 November, the closing day of the Biennale, we gather at the pavilion.
